scope: The 150 original frontend audit finding groups. Overlapping findings retain their original IDs; this is not a count of independent root causes or an application coverage percentage.
pathBase: Paths resolve relative to this audit directory.

dispositionMeaning.resolved-within-recorded-scope: The original finding was implemented or already resolved, revalidated, and supported by its named bounded evidence plus the recorded integration/correction checks. This is not a claim of every application state, wallet, host or physical device being tested.
dispositionMeaning.open-partially-addressed: Local infrastructure and bounded regressions are verified, but the original broader release acceptance remains open.

runResults.correction: The Base lifecycle assertion raced React commit; a test-only correction passed 42 all-project checks and 30 WebKit repeats.

runResults.note: Mint 42; Base 42 plus 30 repeats; Activity 112 line-reporter checks before fixture typing correction, then 28 overlapping corrected checks with raw JSON. These are not summed as unique cases or a second full matrix.

After production corrections. Same Local Test Wallet at three Chromium widths; signed-session and signed-out recovery checks. All six zero page errors; three normal journeys zero observed sends and twelve GET-session 401 responses; three recovery journeys have no separate RPC-method census.
Final optimized build/release isolation/post-build TypeScript passed. Full lint plus later scoped Activity lint, type-boundary ceiling and domain/smoke checks retain their stated checkpoint scope.

notes: The final source checkpoint contains 848 files and was unchanged after build. Ten files differ from the primary matrix checkpoint; their focused corrective evidence is recorded separately.
The original primary failure, 110 intentional skips and unsuccessful earlier attempts remain visible. Overlapping reruns and repeats are not counted as new unique application coverage.

Historical high/medium checkpoints and per-finding priorCheckpoint values remain history, including the earlier G18/BP-13 in-progress observation; current correctionReview records supersede those handoff caveats.
ARC-06 still requires seeded full-provider gameplay, external-wallet/native-host handoff and physical-device/assistive-technology acceptance. Resolving 149 audit groups is not a 100% coverage claim.
